title: 1729 Prairie's ivy closes over its round-arched light
items: In leaf, the ivy on the Pullman house's Prairie front now runs over the head of the ground-floor round-arched light up to the belt course, as the Detroit Publishing photograph shows it. Before, it stopped at the window's sides and left a bare band of wall above the arch.
The leaves stand just clear of the arch, so the light's moulded head and its glass still show under them.
